track.title: Homayoun: Zarbi
track.notes: Tagged title: Zarbi Homayoun. A different performance from the Homayoun suites of 'Lord of Setar' and 'Setar' (no onset alignment).

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gk4 and dwells most on F in Zarbi. The line peaks at C5 (517.7 Hz) at 1:23.7. It closes on Eb3, not the tonic (Gk4 → F3 → F4 → Gk4 → F4 → Eb3).
